title: Autonomous exploration: the JEV mesh designs its own test plan
description: A tireless tester should not need a hand-written script; it should look at the product and decide what is worth testing.
approach: With no script, Argus inventories the live cockpit's affordances, asks the JEV mesh to design four ground-truth test scenarios for what it found, then executes a grounded one: every drone the simulator reports must appear in the cockpit, with none invented.
steps: [  3.7s] Argus opens the cockpit with no script and inventories its affordances
[ 11.7s] Argus asks the JEV mesh to design ground-truth test scenarios for what it found
[ 29.0s] Argus executes a grounded check from its own plan: does the cockpit's fleet match reality?
